emma (docs): heads up — found a mismatch in the quickstart. curl examples use REDWOOD_API_KEY but the TS snippet references REDWOOD_API_TOKEN. users are getting auth errors.
liam (devex): can you paste the exact lines? i can patch the docs quickly.
emma (docs): sure — curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"prompt": "hi"}'```
emma (docs): ts sample: ```const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_TOKEN });```
sofia (engineer): ah yeah that's a copy/paste drift from when we renamed env var last q. should be `REDWOOD_API_KEY` everywhere.
liam (devex): nice catch. also note PowerShell users will trip on single- vs double-quotes for the curl header. maybe add a short note.
sofia (engineer): propose change: TS -> `apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` and add small footnote: "Windows PowerShell: use $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY or escape quotes".
nate (product): bump to patch release? docs-only but customer-facing onboarding pain. recommend patch doc deploy tomorrow morning.
emma (docs): i'll open a tiny PR now with the fix + PS note. cc @liam for review.
deploy-bot: build started for docs-site (run #4821)
liam (devex): quick review done, looks good. added an extra example for PowerShell: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"prompt": "hello"}'```
sofia (engineer): tiny nit — for PS the header should be wrapped in double quotes and the env var expanded by the shell: `-H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY"` (that's what liam has). docs LGTM.
deploy-bot: docs build passed (4821) :white_check_mark:
emma (docs): merged and scheduled for immediate deploy, thanks everyone :tada:
liam (devex): leaving a short entry in the docs changelog about env var parity and quoting gotchas.
sofia (engineer): can we add a test in the docs smoke suite that renders both curl and sdk blocks and checks for same env var name? would prevent regression.
emma (docs): yes good idea — i'll follow up with a tiny smoke test PR later.
liam (devex): thanks — closing thread once smoke test PR is up.
emma (docs): marking fixed in our tracking doc.
